# Hostylia

> Smart residential operating system for hostels, boarding schools, student housing, PGs and co-living — one platform for rooms, fees, attendance, complaints and security.

Hostylia is a cloud-based property management platform built specifically for residential properties that house students and young professionals. It unifies room and bed inventory, student records, fee collection, complaint tracking, parent communication, security workflows and AI-powered insights into a single dashboard.
